finding_dispositions.code: with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=1.5, context=context) as response:
finding_dispositions.rationale: Maintainer launcher polls the local service's /health on 127.0.0.1 only; the scheme is a choice between http and https made by the launcher's own --tls-cert/--tls-key flags, never from input. With TLS the certificate is not verified because the probe asks only whether the service this launcher just started answers on loopback.

Intentional and opt-in (SD-012): the launcher binds all interfaces only for --phone or MUCARO_AI_PHONE_ACCESS=1; the default launch stays on 127.0.0.1. The service then refuses to start without an operator token of 32+ characters (the launcher generates one per launch), and refuses a remote client that has no valid token. Residual risk, accepted and documented in docs/PHONE_ACCESS.md: over plain http the token and content are readable by anyone able to observe the local network, so the launcher prints a cleartext warning and offers --tls-cert/--tls-key. The packaged desktop app is not affected and stays loopback-only (network_exposure gate).
